notes.title: Patch 1.019
notes.content:
Hey guys



It's been a little while, decided to post a quick update.

Mostly to prove I'm still alive and haven't walked away indefinitely.

I wouldn't abandon any games I've released, ain't about that life.

So if there's ever any radio silence for some time then something's probably wrong lol



Changelog:

Added the option to have non-gibbed enemy bodies stay

Added the option to have non-gibbed human enemies always ragdoll



It's not a huge one, granted, but there were requests for these so why not?


Updates and shitUltra Cop Content
Apologies for how long the big updates are taking.

I know you guys have WAY better stuff to be doing anyways, and no one's sitting around waiting for Ultra Cop updates, but I feel guilty for not keeping you guys in the loop.

The way I do level creation takes an ungodly amount of time, my fault obviously, but it looks better that way in the end. 

I'm gonna release the first 2 of the 4 mission maps the moment they're done, just to keep the content flowing, instead of waiting until all are completed. After that the 2 survival maps, then the cosmetic stuff.


Next Game shit
One of the reasons the Ultra Cop updates are slower, is because I have this existential worry about not releasing more new games. 

Makes me feel like a proper knob, I'll tell ya what.

I have been making prototypes and quick idea projects to figure out how to lessen the amount of time it takes to make smaller games that are fun but won't take forever to create.

There's no silver bullet, unfortunately.

Especially if you're retarded like me.



The Saturn's Gaze and Twisted Metal-like projects have been constantly reconfigured or restarted since I've told you guys about it.

ALL MY FAULT OBVIOUSLY 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253929/c3d7fd447bf943623698dc05650f345f16b663a1.gif"]



In fact I'm gonna make my life harder and show some of it here so we can all laugh at it together, proving that I have in fact been wasting precious life hours making shit that no one will ever care about ːsteamthumbsupː 
[previewyoutube="7Ibsw420HBY;full"][/previewyoutube]


The first from the video is the car combat prototype, had to figure out how to emulate the Twisted Metal style controls. Didn't exactly succeed, but it's close enough and responsive.



The second prototype is the stealth game that would have been part of Saturn's Gaze, where you control a cheerleader that's been kidnapped and placed in an environment where demons are hunting you and you gotta use items and sneak. FPS Booba was inspired by Jurassic Park: Trespasser.

The idea is there's traps and demons that would kill you horribly and the screenshot with the tiles is where you get to see the gruesome event as a cutscene. Sick I know, would would make something like that?



Third is a fast-paced action prototype in the style of PS1 era cel shading, specifically from the game, Slap Happy Rhythm Busters. In fact i modeled and painted the player character according the the style of that game to a tee, that's how much i vibed with it. 

Don't know if anyone would rather prefer this one be developed further though.

And yes, booba.

I will have booba in my games if i can help it (not a gooner lol) 


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253929/8bdce595fa8c7db0ba8249028f16e0885ceb7ee2.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253929/da3ff8f5d5b59bded9100d7bf789e0e5ad8b158f.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253929/e8a155e0b6ea9fb8a171e9c65f8750a15b90ca80.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253929/74853c36a0162eded3dc24ad05ba05eb78eb0d5b.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253929/5f8f6eb60bf2085f9f0537ad3da3f9277fef72c6.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253929/c58f41c8164f8170b05652cf30bd5c8c866231ea.jpg"][/carousel]


Really wonder why I even bother sometimes, can probably fill a graveyard with all the uncompleted and forgotten projects. 

I know that's just how things are, but it sucks man lol

Anyways I'll stop bitching and moaning out the ass.

Next update will hopefully be more positive and less lame ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Patch 1.017 - Small Fixes
notes.content:
Hey guys

Quick update to address (attempts to at least) some stupid issues that I missed or caused.

Changelog:

Attempted to fix resolution resetting bug within Windowed Mode 
Added a Resolution scaler in the Video Settings to reduce perceived resolution
Removed forced internal Anti-Aliasing unless it is toggled in Video Settings
Fixed particle effects on Support Enemies
Increased Sparks incendiary weapon chance to set enemies on fire (33% likely now)
Fixed Sparks off-center aiming to shoot where crosshair is pointing


The resolution reset problem was a pain to circumvent. 
This bug has been with Unity for a VERY long time, from what I can tell.
I used a very hacky solution to force the engine to respect the selected Resolution when in Windowed mode.
It works, but it's not pretty. 
If you wanted to break the game by messing with the setting and view modes, you most likely could.
I never intended to have Ultra Cop be played outside Exclusive Fullscreen, but the ability to toggle  to Windowed mode is still enabled for those who want it.

Hope you guys have a good weekend, will keep updating as time goes on ːsteamthumbsupː
- JG

When these are added/fixed I'll move on to the new levels and modes.

notes.title: Patch 1.013
notes.content:
Hey dudes

This is a small update before the more significant updates that are to follow.
I was ill on and off for the past three weeks (no strange orb or fog here lol) and this update is a simple way to get the ball rolling again, and it's proof of life.

Changelog:

Mech can now "sprint"
Mines health decreased to 1 hit point
Heavy Machine Gun accuracy increased 
Submachine Gun accuracy increased, damage decreased by 1
Improved Weapon Case choice detection

The biggest change here is that the Mech can now move faster by holding the sprint button.
It looks a bit silly, but you guys wanted it and I'm happy to oblige.

Content Pipeline
I'm going to break the content update up into smaller, more manageable pieces.
This will make it easier to iterate and fix anything that comes with it as a by-product.

Here is how I'm going to approach it:
[olist]
Difficulty Update - Menu with options to customize you gameplay difficulty
Maps Update - Four campaign missions and two Survival missions
Customization/Cosmetic Update - Menu where you can change player, team and vehicle skins
[/olist] 
Most of the Difficulty update is already in place, just need to create more assets to make it work. 
This involves having new enemy units to increase the challenge (if you so choose).
Also I'll be adding a Tank vehicle and possibly a flying type of vehicle.
If it all works out, you'll be able to enable them from the Difficulty menu.
These are mostly for fun, and I consider them extra's.
It'll be out soon I hope.

Conclusion
I'm trying to get into the groove of things again, so apologies if things are a bit slow in the beginning.
As usual let me know if you guys have any suggestions or questions.

Hope 2025 treats you guys and your loved ones well, no matter your background or beliefs.
Love ya guyzzz

notes.title: Content Roadmap
notes.content:
Hey guys

Just a quick summary as to what the "plans" are going forward if any of you are interested.
The idea is to work on both Ultra Cop content and the next game thing i planned a while back, and will switch between them occasionally to reduce the chance of burnout/fatigue. 
Really want to improve my output in 2025 going forward.
Will obviously keep fixing any bugs in the meantime too ːsteamthumbsupː

The original roadmap i posted on CARNAL's page was as follows:

Ultra Cop (2024)
Saturn's Gaze (2025)
Unnamed Car combat game (2025?)
CARNAL: Reborn, a free remaster update (2026?)

These things are not concrete obviously, as i'm just one dude and life can sometimes throw curve balls at your face. 
But that is the longish term plan so far.

Ultra Cop Content
I've started to make new content for Ultra Cop, and when it's finished it'll be added as a free update. 
A lot of you asked for more levels and i honestly wasn't initially planning on having the game be anything more than it is now, but seeing as you're all such cool dudes I couldn't say no <3
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253929/6a550859eb6a67f55e872562d5baab0f562a5a75.gif
^You guys^

Here's what i'll try to add:

Four main missions
Two Survival Mode maps
Four new Primary weapons
Difficulty selector
More achievements*
Any cool ideas along the way

The aim is to have the new levels be more intense, impressive and hopefully fun.
I've taken notes of the things you guys asked and will try to do them as best i can.

Can't reliably predict when this stuff will be completed, but it will be somewhere in 2025.
The way i made these levels takes a bit longer than they did in CARNAL, cause i was trying to make them like how the professionals did back in the day. 
I'm not them, so it took way longer than it probably needed to :D

*The achievements are still in a weird place right now, if you've finished any of the levels you probably saw that the achievements don't have pictures/icons. 
My best guess is that the game is still not considered as trustworthy or a real game.  
This was the same for CARNAL, but it eventually shifted towards the "Profile Features Limited" status.
Ultra Cop is still sus as far as Steam is considered, so that means there won't be any profile badges, trading cards, backgrounds or emotes until they think the game is real or successful, i.e makes enough money. The game is not qualified for those features yet.
I still don't know how much money is enough according to Valve, but CARNAL never reached that threshold, so i'm not sure what Ultra Cop's chances are.
So i'll add the achievements, but know that it may never show on your profile or show as "Completed" in your games list.

Whether Ultra Cop is good or sucks the big one is not the be all end all honestly, as the fact that the game even released is a huge miracle in my eyes, especially after three and a half years of not getting anything done and fighting with the asperger's.
This release has given me energy to continue and hope that i can make more stuff, breaking the dry spell in a way.

Thanks for giving the game a chance, and know that i appreciate any feedback you guys can give.
It's a humbling/terrifying experience, especially when i break the game with updates lol

Saturn's Gaze
It's a working title but maybe it'll stick who knows.
The initial idea was to make a stealth game in the vein of Thief/Splinter Cell.
After some pondering and looking at what a lot of you guys like, i'm thinking that perhaps a pure stealth game is not what most are looking for, i could be very wrong, please let me know.

So the concept has shifted towards something of a mixture, where the main campaign revolves around shooting crap and driving a motorcycle, and having a seperate campaign where you control a different character that has to use stealth to survive.

It will have a PSX/PS1 style and i will slavishly try to make it an authentic 5th Gen experience.

For the sake of not boring anyone with dumb details, the premise came from a quick sketch i made a couple years back on an old ass Samsung tablet. Please excuse my afwul art lol:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253929/b9b5bb63d49951cafe841e94c1b1e3952168ca55.png

It'll involve vampires, bloodlines, nephilim/cryptids and blowing shit up. In no particular order.
Think John Carpenter's Vampires (1998) mixed with Blade (1998).
Ok maybe that's too cool of an ideal for me to reach realistically, so temper expectations lol 

I fucked up with PAGAN, and that has spurred me to focus on doing something and sticking with it to the end.
I'm gonna go for it, and like i mentioned above, will work on this on and off with the hope of releasing a finished game in 2025, taking lessons learned here with Ultra Cop.

Hopefully this can materialize and be a cool/fun thing to play ːsteamthumbsupː

Conclusion
The other games are a "we'll cross that bridge when we get there" sort of situation.
My first priority is Ultra Cop content and updates, then Saturn's Gaze.
Again thanks for showing any interest, and even more i'm grateful to all of you who bought Ultra Cop.
My appreciation is through the roof, and i hope to do right by you guys going forward.
Obviously as long as the following does not happen:

I stop breathing
My computer explodes
The economy crumbles
UFO's attack

If God keeps my moronic ass alive, expect something in the pipeline, obviously only if you're interested ːsteamthumbsupː

In the meantime, please play great games, spend time with your loved ones and enjoy your lives to the fullest. 2025 will bring its own challenges. Enjoy the holidays! 

Cheers and thanks
- JG

notes.title: Patch 1.008 - Jumpin' Jacks
notes.content:
Hey guys

Another day, another update. I make broken games and make even more broken updates.
Here is a new cooked update fresh from the jank oven lol.

Changelog:

Redone Jumping code to offset the issues with the double jump
Added an aiming sensitivity slider in the System Settings
Added more sounds to audio mixers
Improved tarp wall collisions on Mission 2
Screamed into a pillow

The issue with how jumping works in the game is still weird and the game is still locked to internally run its code at 60 fps, even though you cool guys own super graphics cards/monitors that try to render the game at 1000 fps, causing Unity to shit the bed. 
Because of this graphics driver related issue, i reworked the code responsible for calculating the double jumping mechanic.
It's simplified and much less fussy about what conditions need to be met. 
Can't promise that it's completely fixed, but hope remains in the heart of the foolish developer.

Also thanks for letting me know about the various sound effects in the game that don't respond to the audio mixers in the volume settings. 
Really, really sorry about that inconvenience and unintentional, yet possibly humorous scares that it no doubt provided.

What's Next?
There are quite a few things you guys requested, namely new content in the form of missions, survival/horde modes and weapons.

I will begin work on that very soon and hopefully have it out to you guys in a timely fashion.
It might take a while, seeing as there will be new level assets, animations, sounds, systems, etc.

That being said I want to start planning on the next game, and will ask you guys to answer a quick poll somewhere in the future on what style you guys would be most interested in.
I have a roadmap, but i'd rather hear from you guys first before i make a game that no one cares about.

Cheers

notes.title: Patch 1.007
notes.content:
Hey guys

I removed the Refresh Rate slider.
Seems it did make things worse. I reverted the game back to its old 60 fps self.  
The only way to have stable performance and no-lag input is to set the game in your graphics driver to run at 60 fps, if you are someone with a higher refresh rate monitor that is.
For most people i believe this will be no issue.
Sorry for the inconvenience, it seems i'm not quite done with this issue. Unsure if this is a Unity thing, or a Nvidia/AMD thing. 
Will look out for possible fixes.

Also i added more sounds to the mixers. I'm certain there are more but there are a gajillion sound making things and just when i think i got them all, more pop up.
I hate it here :D

Hope you dudes had a good weekend at least ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Patch 1.006
notes.content:
Hey guys

I have tried to fix a bunch of stuff you all mentioned, so here is a quick rundown of said possible fixes.

Changelog:

Added a refresh rate slider in the Video Settings screen*
Changed Main menu music to loop
Added more sounds to mixers so that they will be affected by audio settings
Added two special ammo pickups to the starting tunnel of Mission 1, because I couldn't get the camera to behave and point in the right direction.
Fixed a collision issue on Mission 4.
Added fire and smoke to player vehicles when they reach quarter health.
Changed vehicle health bars to change colour depending on damage (green, yellow, orange, red).
Added a burning flare that creates smoke to signal where the extraction box is located after objectives are completed.
Added controller support fixes to the main menu and mission select screen.
Attempted to have the game save your best stats per mission as well as carry over mission time if not completed.


*This new setting might fix some input related lag some of you guys have been experiencing. But beware though, this setting will affect how fast the game will need to run on your system. So it might be best not to set it too high. 
It appears the reason why things were strange is because graphics card drivers (Nvidia and AMD) were overriding the framerate of the game, regardless of what your in-game settings are. 
So i chose to skip some steps and affect the internal rendering so that the drivers don't have as much influence over performance. 
This may or may not fuck up the game, but I guess we'll have to wait and see :)

Thanks for the suggestions and bug reports you guys have given so far, it really helps a ton.
And thanks for giving the game a fair shot.

If anything here is still busted or you find new stuff, please don't hesitate to bring it up!

I have made lists of all the future stuff you guys want from the game, and will begin on that very soon ːsteamthumbsupː

Cheers
- JG

notes.title: Patch 1.004
notes.content:
Hey guys!

I have attempted to fix the unresponsive jumping some of you guys have experienced.
I admit i'm not exactly having this same issue, but i'm sure there's more variables to this specific quirk.

Changelog:

Made all input checks independent from framerate
Made all player collision and ground checks independent from framerate
 
A very real problem is that i've been working on this game for so long that i just got used to the jank.
If this issue is not solved with the above mentioned remedies, please explain to me exactly what is happening on your end and what your specs/refresh rate is, cause it might have something to do with hardware related stuff and i'm just too stupid to realize what the real culprit is.

Also just to clarify there is a double jump mechanic in the game. I realize only now that i really didn't make it obvious for any new players, so just to explain: 

When the player leaves the ground, either by jumping or falling off something, they have an extra jump while mid-air. 

I'm not sure if this is one of the mechanics messing up the flow of jumping, but i'd really like to hear what you guys think about its implementation. 
Perhaps i've drank the kool-aid and think it's fine when in reality it's complete garbage!

Anyways thanks for checking out the game bro's!
Cheers
-JG

notes.title: Ultra Cop - Releases 20 November
notes.content:
Hey guys

Ultra Cop is releasing tomorrow the 20th, midnight South African time.
It's finally finished, or at least I hope it is lol

I really, really want you guys to have as much info available to you before you maybe decide to try out Ultra Cop, as it's quite a bit different from CARNAL in terms of design and style. 
This is a budget game made with no budget.

The last thing I want is for anyone to feel like they got something they didn't sign up for, or that they feel ripped off in any way.

What follows here is a quick recap of the game and its scope:

What Should I Expect?
In my mind I was making a game that could have been a launch title for the Sega Dreamcast, aesthetically and tech wise.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45253929/7db729010070b7c1eea656fe0d802e7ab9a442f1.gif

Imagine a Y2K era arcade experience where you play for 15-30 minutes, and then go on with your day.
A stress reliever with bite lol.

This is an unserious game that could have fit on a demo disc that came with a gaming magazine circa 1999. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1DAlh79G4XA

A game that could fit on a GD-ROM.
I don't know if I achieved what I set out to do, but at least you guys can have an idea of what the goal was.

How Long is the Game?
There are four missions in the game, which can be played in any order.
A blind playthrough would probably take an hour to complete, more or less.
The idea behind this game, and others that will follow in time, is that they are meant
to be shorter arcade-like experiences. 
Quick jump in and play sort of vibes. 

How Much Will It Cost?
Ultra Cop will sell for $2 US.
On sale it will be anywhere from $1 to $0.50.
It's a dollar more than CARNAL, the idea being that it stands a slightly better chance of being accepted by Steam one day for full profile features (public achievements, trading cards, etc).

Will This Be Supported Further?
I will support this game until almost every possible issue is sorted out.
I won't delude myself into thinking that there won't be any issues after release, after all it's a one-man show. Problems are just waiting to reveal themselves lol.
Feel free to create a topic in the discussions page if you run into any issues.

What If I Don't Like The Game?
I say this with all due respect; please do not hold onto this game if you're dissatisfied in any way.
Ensure that you apply for a refund before the two week cut-off and before the two hour play-time check.
Again, I don't want anyone to feel like they got ripped off or short changed.
Constructive reviews are welcome, positive or negative.

Conclusion
This is another silly game, and it's not a serious project whatsoever.
Still it's something I'm glad I saw through to the end in what has proven to be a very difficult year for me, both health and career wise.
So whether this game succeeds or flops hard, I'm just grateful that I got this far.
God knows I almost didn't.

Thanks for checking out this little thing and reading if you did ːsteamthumbsupː
Cheers!
- JG Roos
